PartyCreditProfileAlert.name: PartyCreditProfileAlert
PartyCreditProfileAlert.description: Represents the alerts and triggers raised against a borrower's credit activities, such as sudden score changes, new accounts, and payment defaults. Aids in detecting fraud, identifying borrower errors, and facilitating verification processes.
